regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is bifurcated: Diversified Miners lead the composite score by a wide margin (1.992 vs 0.85 for Conglomerates & Exchange) but are NOT trend-eligible (gate filtered them out), while the highest actual gate-eligible themes are Conglomerates & Exchange, High-Dividend Blue Chips, and Tech Hardware & Semis. Rotation absorption is low (0.48) and breadth of eligible themes is narrowing (6/17), suggesting a thinning, low-conviction tape rather than a broad risk-on regime. I will lean only where the validated absolute-trend gate actually admits a theme.
emerging_watch: Watching Diversified Miners for a confirmed gate-flip back to eligible (it currently leads the composite score at 1.992 but is excluded by the absolute-trend gate). The observable condition to retire this watch is a closure back above its trend threshold that flips eligible from false to true while breadth stays at 1.0.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is one of only six gate-eligible themes and carries the highest durability_bar of any eligible name (0.82), with full breadth (1.0) and a 'trend' hurst tag. Under a discipline-not-prediction reading, this is the cleanest expression of trend-staying-power within the eligible set — not a momentum bet, but the theme most consistent with the one validated edge (drawdown/shake-out control via absolute-trend gate), and it is not crowded.
theses.dissent: High-dividend names are rate-sensitive; if HKD/H-shares yields compress on a global risk-on or a China policy pivot toward growth over income, the trend can stall without any momentum deterioration. The score itself (0.555) is mid-table, not leadership.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips theme closes below its 20-day moving average while the Hang Seng is flat or up before the check-by date

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
theses.thesis: This is the headline (weight 0.25) and the highest-ranked gate-eligible theme (rank 2, score 0.85). Durability is healthy at 0.77 with full breadth (1.0) and a 'mixed' hurst tag. As the challenger in the rotation read with the leader (Miners) ineligible, Conglomerates & Exchange is the de facto eligible leadership expression. I lean with it only as long as the gate continues to admit it — it is a staying-power call, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Conglomerates/exchange proxies are highly sensitive to HK turnover and IPO/policy flow; a liquidity pullback in the HSI or a resumption of US-China friction would hit the exchange component hardest. The hurst tag is 'mixed', not a clean trend.

falsifier.text: Conglomerates & Exchange theme breadth falls below 0.6 and durability drops under 0.6 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Gate-eligible and trend-tagged with durability 0.73, but breadth is only 0.5 — the narrowest eligible breadth outside Banks. This is a small-internal-divergence read: the theme is holding up on trend health but participation is thin. I lean with it only on the absolute-trend gate leg, not on rank, and flag that the thin breadth makes it the most fragile of the three eligible leaders.
theses.dissent: Semis are globally cyclical and highly beta to the AI macro narrative (which dominates the macro backdrop at n=62); a single AI chain earnings or export-control headline could compress breadth further and break the trend without warning.

falsifier.text: Tech Hardware & Semis breadth drops below 0.35 while durability falls under 0.65 before the check-by date
